## What this is

This site is the interactive companion to the working paper *Collateral Constraints
and Endogenous Liquidity Stress: The Central Bank Collateral Framework as a Financial
Stability Tool* (Cuzzola, Barbieri & Bindseil). It serves two purposes the printed
paper cannot:

- **Room the paper does not have.** Where the manuscript reports a single summary
  exhibit — the cross-scenario robustness table, for instance — this site shows the
  full set of exhibits behind it, one per scenario.
- **Mechanics you can move.** Interactive and illustrative visuals introduce how the
  model works: how banks move through the capital–liquidity plane under stress, and
  why the same asset carries a different liquidity value in each funding channel.

## Confidentiality

Everything here is **aggregated to groups of at least three banks**. The site is
built from a curated export of group-level results only; it contains no bank-level
data, and the underlying supervisory inputs are never published.

## How to cite

Please cite the working paper. A formal citation and DOI will be added here once the
paper is finalised.
